per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must handle at least 1,000 concurrent requests on day one and scale to approximately double that in the next major release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must support Java 11 and 17, with preference for vendor certification for at least one LTS version and compatibility guarantees for the other.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be deployable in both Tomcat and JBoss scenarios without requiring server-specific hacks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must support Oracle, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL databases with failover awareness and connection pooling.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will require collaboration with a database management system (DBMS). The DBMS may be located on the same machine as the product or on a separate machine residing on the same computer network.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Routine operations must complete in ≤5 seconds (90th percentile) and ≤8 seconds (99th percentile).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must achieve 99.99% uptime (four nines) on a monthly basis with redundancy through clustering and load balancers.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must provide structured exception logging with context (request IDs, user or tenant context, timestamps, server instance identifiers, stack traces) and scrub logs of PII before transmission.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must support at least eight representative browsers (including Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, and mobile variants) with around 80% compatibility.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must support per-user and per-tenant language selection with initial support for English, Spanish, and French.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA for accessibility, including keyboard navigation, ARIA roles, color contrast, and screen reader compatibility.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must support SSO via SAML, OAuth flows for integrations, TLS encryption, RBAC, and secure defaults with the ability to rotate credentials and certificates.
The system must support load tests that simulate realistic user behavior, including peak bursts, and achieve the specified performance SLAs.
The system must support structured exception logging with context and secure transmission to the vendor's support system for deeper cause analysis.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'
